details.name: Auriel
details.looks: Young alien woman, pale skin with scattering of pinkish-orange freckles on nose and cheeks, iridescent particles shimmer on upper cheekbones, intense bright blue eyes, long dark eyelashes, well-defined arched eyebrows, muted pinkish-peach lips, very long straight platinum blonde hair.
details.wearing: Frosty blue-white crystalline crown-like headpiece resembling ice formations extending from temples. High-necked crystalline collar with spiky elements covering neck and shoulders.
details.face: The face is pale with a scattering of pinkish-orange freckles on the nose and cheeks. Iridescent particles shimmer on the upper cheekbones. The eyes are bright blue, framed by long dark eyelashes and well-defined arched eyebrows. The lips are muted pinkish-peach.
details.body: The image focuses on the head and upper torso; details regarding height, weight, or build are not visible.
details.hair: The hair is very long, straight, and platinum blonde.
details.style: Her aesthetic is one of cool, crystalline elegance, blending organic, natural textures with sharp, geometric crystalline formations. Her palette leans towards frosty blues, ethereal whites, and soft, muted peachy tones, creating a signature look that is both alien and mesmerizingly beautiful. Her style communicates a profound sense of serene otherworldliness, a delicate balance between fragility and an unyielding inner strength.
details.voice: Her voice is a low, resonant hum, with a crystalline clarity that carries a subtle, almost imperceptible tremor. Its tone is cool and measured, like the chime of distant ice bells, capable of conveying immense depth with minimal inflection.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with a deliberate, unhurried cadence, her words chosen with care. Her vocabulary is precise and elegant, often carrying a lyrical quality, though she rarely employs overly elaborate phrasing.

details.face: Delicate East Asian features, clear skin with a subtle blush, full pink lips, downcast brown eyes, and a small nose. No visible wrinkles or scars.
details.body: The character appears to have a slender build. They are shown from the chest up, with a calm and still posture.
details.hair: Short, bob-cut, light blue hair with a messy texture. Silver clips are visible on both temples.
details.style: Her aesthetic is a blend of stark utilitarianism and refined, almost minimalist design. The palette leans towards cool blues, greys, and whites, contrasted with sharp orange and deep red accents, creating a visually striking, functional silhouette that hints at advanced technology and quiet competence.

details.speechStyle: She speaks in measured, concise sentences, choosing her words with care and often pausing to consider her response, favoring directness over embellishment.
